name: FoundersPrime
subcategory: startup deals · cloud credits · grants · accelerators
tagline: Verified startup deals, cloud credits, SaaS discounts, grants, and founder programs

pricing.notes: Live pricing page (2026-08-03): Next'Founder $1 first month then $14.99/yr (students); Founder $9.99 first month then $48/yr (most popular); Legend $99 one-time lifetime. Listed priceMonthly is Founder annual ÷ 12 ≈ $4.

verdictSummary: A personal spreadsheet or Markdown catalog of public startup deals is one-shottable. The hard part is continuously verifying cloud credits, SaaS discounts, grants, and accelerator eligibility · that curated database is the product, not the UI shell.
coreLoopDIY: Maintain a local searchable catalog of startup deals with tags for cloud, SaaS, ads, grants, and accelerators, plus expiry dates and eligibility notes.
requirements: manual research or scrape scripts for public deal pages
browser access to vendor program pages
whatYouLose: weekly-verified deal freshness across hundreds of programs
breadth of cloud credits, SaaS discounts, grants, and accelerators in one place
eligibility notes and search/filters polished for founders
agent-friendly catalog APIs and ongoing research labor
someone else chasing expired coupons so you do not
moatNotes: value is curated verification of deals and programs, not a unique widget
whyPeopleStillPay: Founders pay to skip hours of hunting scattered vendor pages and expired promos. The subscription buys research time, trust, and a maintained catalog · a DIY list goes stale within weeks without continuous upkeep.
notes: Founders deals and credits terminal. Logo is black/white/yellow FP mark from foundersprime.com.
prompt:
Build a local startup-deals catalog (Next.js or plain HTML + SQLite). Requirements:

- CRUD for deals: name, vendor URL, category (cloud / SaaS / ads / grant / accelerator),
  amount or %, expiry date, eligibility notes, verified checkbox, tags.
- UI: search + filter by category and expiry, table + detail panel, export JSON/CSV.
- Seed 15 placeholder deals with realistic names (no live scrapers).
- Stack: Next.js App Router + SQLite (better-sqlite3 or libsql) OR static JSON +
  client search if you want zero native deps. Pick one and ship.
- README with setup and how to add deals by hand.

Out of scope: payments, multi-user accounts, live scraping of third-party sites,
mobile apps, claiming real vendor credits.

Deliver a runnable app in one folder with npm run dev.
